content.json:
## CivicGrant
How the API is doing: traffic, refusals, server errors, slow operations, the grant workflow and the log lines worth a look. Health probes (`/actuator/health`) are left out everywhere: they are most of the traffic and say nothing about users.

content.query:
let api = AppRequests
    | where Name !startswith 'GET /actuator';
union
    (api | summarize value = todouble(count()) | extend label = 'API requests', order = 1),
    (api | summarize value = todouble(countif(toint(ResultCode) between (400 .. 499))) | extend label = 'Refused (4xx)', order = 2),
    (api | summarize value = todouble(countif(toint(ResultCode) >= 500)) | extend label = 'Server errors (5xx)', order = 3),
    (api | summarize value = round(percentile(DurationMs, 95)) | extend label = '95th percentile (ms)', order = 4)
| sort by order asc
| project label, value
content.title: API at a glance

content.query:
AppRequests
| where Name !startswith 'GET /actuator'
| extend status = strcat(substring(ResultCode, 0, 1), 'xx')
| summarize requests = count() by status, bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Requests over time, by status class

content.query:
AppRequests
| where Name !startswith 'GET /actuator'
| summarize
    ['Requests'] = count(),
    ['4xx'] = countif(toint(ResultCode) between (400 .. 499)),
    ['5xx'] = countif(toint(ResultCode) >= 500),
    ['95th percentile (ms)'] = round(percentile(DurationMs, 95))
    by ['Operation'] = Name
| sort by ['Requests'] desc
content.title: Per operation

content.query:
let steps = AppMetrics
    | where Name == 'civicgrant_applications'
    | summarize value = sum(Sum) by label = tostring(Properties.event);
let granted = AppMetrics
    | where Name == 'civicgrant_grants_amount'
    | summarize value = sum(Sum)
    | extend label = 'euros granted';
union steps, granted
| extend order = case(label == 'created', 1, label == 'submitted', 2, label == 'assessed', 3, label == 'approved', 4, label == 'rejected', 5, 6)
| sort by order asc
| project label, value
content.title: Grant workflow

content.query:
AppMetrics
| where Name == 'civicgrant_applications'
| summarize applications = sum(Sum) by step = tostring(Properties.event), bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Grant workflow over time

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs
| extend entry = parse_json(Log)
| extend level = tostring(entry.log.level)
| where level in ('WARN', 'ERROR')
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    level,
    logger = tostring(entry.log.logger),
    message = tostring(entry.message),
    error = trim(' ', strcat(tostring(entry.error.type), ' ', tostring(entry.error.message))),
    OperationId = tostring(entry.trace_id),
    RevisionName
| join kind=leftouter (AppRequests | project OperationId, request = Name, ResultCode) on OperationId
| project TimeGenerated, level, request, ResultCode, logger, message, error, OperationId, RevisionName
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: Warnings and errors in the logs, with their request
content.noDataMessage: No warnings or errors in this time range.
